shared_elements: repeated units arranged in a horizontal row/band
justification: The only shared content is the generic device of repeated small units set in horizontal rows bounded by lines: rows of block-like glyph cells in A and rows of figures in a register band in B. A depicts an abstract emblematic composition (a large hatched disc with small paired oval signs inside a rectangular glyph border) with no human or animal forms, while B depicts naturalistic processions of standing human figures and animals in profile; the conventions of rendering are entirely unrelated.
